---
title: Create a card
description: Give a new card a non-blank title.
---

A card title must contain at least one non-whitespace character. The **Create card** button stays disabled when the title is empty or contains only whitespace.

1. Open the new-card form on your board.
2. Enter a descriptive title, such as `Prepare release notes`.
3. Complete the other fields you need, then select **Create card**.

Leading and trailing whitespace is removed before the card is submitted. For example, `  Prepare release notes  ` is saved as `Prepare release notes`.

If the button remains disabled, replace the blank or whitespace-only title with a descriptive title. The API enforces the same non-blank rule even if a client bypasses the form.

---
title: Rename a card
description: Change a card title and recover from an empty-title edit.
---

Open the card details and edit its title. Enter at least one non-whitespace character before saving the change.

Leading and trailing whitespace is removed when the title is submitted. For example, `  Release checklist  ` becomes `Release checklist`.

## If the title is blank

If you submit an empty or whitespace-only title, Kan restores the previous title and displays:

- **Unable to update card**
- **Card title cannot be empty.**

Enter a non-blank title and submit the change again. The rejected blank edit does not replace the existing card title.

---
title: Card title validation
description: Title normalization and validation for create, update and duplicate operations.
---

The card router trims leading and trailing whitespace before validating a supplied title. The normalized title must contain between 1 and 2,000 characters.

| Operation | Title requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Create a card | Required; blank or whitespace-only values are rejected. |
| Update a card | Optional; when supplied, the title must pass trimming and length validation. |
| Duplicate a card | Optional; when supplied, the title must pass the same validation. |

Omitting an optional title differs from supplying an empty string. A description-only update can omit the title; supplying `""`, spaces, tabs or line breaks does not bypass title validation.

For example, `"  Release checklist  "` normalizes to `"Release checklist"`. A whitespace-only title fails input validation before the requested database write.

These rules apply in addition to the operation’s other required fields and permissions.
edits.reason: Document the title-validation behavior in packages/api/src/routers/card.ts changed by PR #15.
